title: Add, edit and auto-append projects in ~/.dashboard/projects.yaml from the dashboard command
notes: Shipped in #223: dashboard project add, set (--aka adds, --deploy adds or updates by name, --site/--about replace, --clear) and remove, all through src/main/projects/projects-write.ts (keeps comments, validated by readProjects, atomic replaceFile). The app appends name and path for any project it opens that the file lacks. The CLAUDE.md snippet in docs/command/README.md tells agents to record deploys, sites and aliases with project set. Not done: a removed project whose page is still open comes back at the next launch (documented); no lock between the app's append and a concurrent set.

comments.body: The user (2026-11-05): when an agent learns something new about a project, say a test environment and its address, it should be recorded. So: --deploy on 'project set' adds or updates one deployment by name (never wipes the others), and the CLAUDE.md snippet in docs/command/README.md tells agents to run 'dashboard project set <name> --deploy name=...,role=...,address=...' when they find a deployment, a site or an alias the file does not have. Same for --aka (adds, does not replace) and --site/--about (replace).
